messages:
sam_sales: Hey team — customer (US gov contractor) asked if we can run a sealed-site POC with absolutely no egress. They need: 3x GPU nodes, FIPS/KMS requirements, signed offline bundles, and a defined upgrade cadence. Also asking pricing: one-off vs reserved nodes. Can we outline feasibility and risks?
elaine_se: short answer: yes, but a few blockers to scope. need to confirm model artifact size + whether they want custom quantized weights. also need to know if HSM is required for key storage.
sam_sales: They want to run a quantized LLM (~20B float32 -> 4-bit quant) and will refuse network calls. HSM is preferred but not mandatory for POC.
nora_eng: Packaging plan idea: produce a signed tar.gz bundle containing runtime, model quant files, signed manifest, and SBOM. Provide a USB-delta patch mechanism for hotfixes. We’ll require a short agent that validates signatures and unlocks the bundle. Example manifest snippet: ```{"bundle_version":"202603","sha256":"..."}```
devon_sre: note on ops: without egress we can’t use the automatic telemetry backplane. we can support offline metrics via a local collector that the customer ships back to us, or they can enable an opt-in upload when on a controlled network. hotfixes: we can push a signed delta via offline media, but need an operator runbook.
paul_security: FIPS mode: we must compile with FIPS-validated crypto and document the validation boundary. also need to complete the vendor security questionnaire section on key lifecycle and signing. will need proof of SBOM provenance and reproducible builds.
maria_sales: commercial Qs: do we propose POC as free 90-day with engineering hours capped, or charge a small pilot fee + support retainer? Also need to price node-commit vs per-seat dev licenses.
elaine_se: recommend: 90-day technical POC free (limited to 3 nodes), pilot license for production thereafter. pricing model: reserved node SKU + optional on-prem support/fast-path SLA. add engineering day-rate for offline packaging + HSM integration.
nora_eng: upgrade cadence: security patches quarterly by default. customer asked for monthly vuln patches — we can provide out-of-band hotfixes but that’s an ops burden; recommend a monthly patch window only with paid support add-on.
devon_sre: ops caveat: offline restore/rollback: we need a deterministic upgrade script and signed roll-forward tokens. if customer wants automatic rollbacks, they'll need an acceptability test harness run locally.
paul_security: deliverables to include with POC: signed bundle, SBOM, FIPS build matrix, threat model summary, and a short runbook for key rotation and emergency patching. I’ll draft the security Q responses.
sam_sales: ok — next steps: Elaine and Nora, can you draft a one-page runbook + packaging checklist by EOD Fri? Maria will draft the commercial term (POC + pilot pricing). Paul — ping when SQ draft available. I’ll schedule customer sync for next Tue. :calendar:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: POC-ticket-#13421 created, assignees: @elaine_se @nora_eng, due: 2026-04-02
elaine_se: noted. I’ll include a sample acceptance test: inference latency < 150ms @ 8-token burst, CPU/GPU telemetry local collection enabled, and offline inference correctness tests (prompt set).
maria_sales: I’ll propose: 90d free POC, $25k engineering & packaging fee (one-time) for offline integration, then either $X/month reserved nodes or per-node annual license. will share numbers in the customer thread.
sam_sales: thanks — if anyone sees a non-starter (FIPS or HSM unresolvable) flag it now. otherwise we move forward with runbook + price card.
